# Zero Width Messages

> Dependency-free Python reference implementation of the Zero Width Lab ZWM1 framed
> message protocol by the CodePhFox team.

## Primary documentation

- [README](README.md): installation, examples, limitations, and responsible use.
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): repository map, invariants, safety rules, and verification commands.
- [Protocol specification](docs/PROTOCOL.md): exact alphabet, frame layout, encoding, decoding, and compatibility.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): security boundary and private reporting.
- [Contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): development and pull-request workflow.

## Core source

- [Public API](src/zero_width_messages/__init__.py): supported imports.
- [Protocol implementation](src/zero_width_messages/codec.py): framing and codec behavior.
- [Command-line interface](src/zero_width_messages/cli.py): local CLI and clipboard integration.
- [Package metadata](pyproject.toml): Python support, dependencies, and console entry point.

## Required constraints

- Do not add account automation, tokens, webhooks, or network sending.
- Do not call the hidden payload encrypted, secure, private, or undetectable.
- Preserve ZWM1 compatibility or introduce a new explicit protocol version.
- Preserve LICENSE and NOTICE attribution.
